THE MIND BEHIND THE SOUNDFF / 01

03 / THE PRODUCER

FEX FENIX.

Producer / Engineer / Recording Artist / Creative

Original sound.
No shortcuts.

Raised on hip-hop and reggaeton. Fluent in English and Spanish. Fex Fenix connects Caribbean rhythm with the darkness of Memphis and the weight of Atlanta trap.

From trap and R&B to dembow, reggaeton and Afrobeats, the approach stays personal: melodies composed from scratch, records built from the soul.

Meet Fex Fenix +

Inspired by 808 Mafia, Chopsquad DJ and ATL Jacob, Fex Fenix brings a multicultural ear to production. Unless an artist requests otherwise, approximately 99% of his beats are completely original, with melodies he composes himself.

Production, engineering and creative direction come together here, in a space built around making your next record.
